reopened_reason: Direct ZOE aggregation by the frozen interaction descriptors fails because whole component identity also carries base/support information that the interaction-only quotient intentionally discarded.

new_assertions.body: A coordinate can be sufficient for interaction terms while being insufficient as a whole component identity; quotient validity is role-specific.
The first direct-aggregation failures preserve frontier-relative incidence while changing support height or remaining local capacity, identifying capacity as a missing base coordinate.
Capacity augmentation is independently motivated by the earlier CAP6_REL_INC structural-span result and is therefore not an outcome-selected arbitrary repair.
The next descriptor ladder should hold REL_INC fixed and vary only the capacity grade, separating the necessity of capacity from finer topology questions.
A capacity grade is rejected on any carrier with a mixed scalar class after descriptor aggregation and ZOE count classification; exact-type ZOE remains the control.

add_fixed: direct REL_INC-ZOE and TOPO_RPAR-ZOE aggregation fail Q-V on every demanding carrier tested
interaction-coordinate sufficiency does not imply whole-component identity sufficiency
aggregation failures expose support-height / remaining-capacity distinctions omitted by REL_INC
retain_open: minimal whole-component structural identity under ZOE counts
